card.name: A or an before emphasized numbers
card.fires_on: The article "a" or "an" right before an intensifying adjective and a number, such as astonishing, mere, whopping, remarkable or additional. It fires in statements of amounts, percentages or distances.

modes.label: Emphatic size adjective
modes.description: "a" or "an" before an adjective like whopping, mere, astonishing or remarkable that stresses how big or small a number is.
modes.example: Canadian emissions have increased by<< a>> whopping 24 percent, in great

modes.label: Additional amount
modes.description: "an" before "additional" and a number of years in a follow-up duration.
modes.example: Average follow-up in HERS II was<< an>> additional 2.7 years, for

card.writes: It pushes toward emphatic quantity words like mere, whopping and staggering, and away from plain number words.
card.plain: It marks the little word "a" or "an" just before a dramatic adjective that introduces a number.
